title: Midterm Schedule Changes and Prorated Premium, Larkspur Valuables Floater
content:
Larkspur Valuables Floater rate manual: premium for schedule changes during the term.

**Rule.** An item scheduled, revalued or removed midterm changes the premium by its value divided by 100 times its class rate (after the storage credit), prorated over the calendar days from its effective date to the expiration date and divided by the calendar days in the term, rounded half-up to the cent; below the tier's smallest midterm change nothing is posted. A removal after a paid total loss returns no premium, because the premium for that item is fully earned.

## Terms of the rule

- **Value.** For an item scheduled, the scheduled value; for a revaluation, the increase in value; for a removal, the scheduled value removed.
- **Class rate after the storage credit.** For jewelry or watches on a floater recording a vault or safe credit, the class rate is reduced by that credit's percentage for the tier; for every other class, and where no credit is recorded, the class rate applies unreduced.
- **Proration.** The annual figure is multiplied by the number of calendar days from the change's effective date to the expiration date and divided by the number of calendar days in the term. Rounding, half-up to the cent, is applied to the prorated result.
- **Threshold.** A prorated result below the tier's smallest midterm change is neither billed nor credited; a result equal to or above it is posted.

| Change | Effect on the premium account when posted |
|---|---|
| Item scheduled | additional premium charged |
| Item revalued | additional premium charged on the increase |
| Item removed after sale or gift, or no longer owned | return premium credited |
| Item removed after its total loss was paid | no return premium (fully earned) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Hypothetical term of 365 calendar days expiring on 1 January; change effective 1 September, leaving 122 calendar days.

- **Ring scheduled on a Valuables Floater Preferred recording a vault credit.** 6000 USD is 60 hundreds; multiplied by the jewelry rate of 1.29 gives 77.40; less the 40 percent vault credit gives 46.44; multiplied by 122 and divided by 365 gives 15.5224, rounded half-up to 15.52 USD. That is at least 5.00 USD, so 15.52 USD of additional premium is charged.
- **Silverware sold, removed from a Valuables Floater Prestige.** 1200 USD is 12 hundreds; multiplied by 0.27 gives 3.24; multiplied by 122 and divided by 365 gives 1.08296, rounded half-up to 1.08 USD. That is below 2.00 USD, so no return premium is posted.
- **Watch removed after its total loss was paid.** No return premium, whatever the days remaining.
